From: Acme AI Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>

Cc: GCP Partner Ops <partner-ops@google.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP Marketplace listing: procurement & co-sell sequencing

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for taking this. We're ready to move forward with a GCP Marketplace listing but procurement wants clarity on the exact billing path and contract artifacts before we commit to a PO. A few specific asks from our side: 

- Confirm whether billing will be via GCP Marketplace metered billing (marketplace-managed billing) or an invoiced reseller setup.
- Provide the standard SOW/contract template you use for Marketplace listings + any required procurement fields (billing contact, remit-to, PO acceptance).
- Share an internal map of the handoffs: who owns listing activation, who handles billing exceptions, and who signs off on pricing changes.

We have an internal compliance checklist and will need to align on the procurement timeline — ideally a two-week window to get approvals in our finance system. Can we get a mutual action plan and an intake checklist?

Attachment: [attachment: Acme_GCP_SOW.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]

Best,
Lena Park
Procurement Lead, Acme AI
procurement@acme.ai

--

Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace listing: procurement & co-sell sequencing

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Karthik (billing & marketplace ops) and Vanessa (partner/onboarding) to confirm the internal handoffs. Quick answers up front: 

- Billing model: we support both Marketplace-managed metered billing (preferred for direct marketplace purchases) and invoiced reseller for enterprise contracts. We'll propose the Marketplace metered flow unless Acme needs consolidated invoicing.
- Contract artifacts: see attached intake checklist and a short Redwood appendix that lists the procurement fields we require.

Proposed mutual action plan (high-level):
1) Today: Redwood sends procurement checklist & mapping of internal owners (we've attached checklist).
2) Within 3 business days: Acme returns completed checklist + desired billing model and PO template.
3) Day 4-7: Finance/legal review and redline (if any).
4) Day 8-10: DocuSign for SOW or Marketplace terms; scheduling listing activation once PO is received.

Owner matrix (initial):
- Listing activation: Vanessa Ortiz (Partner Ops)
- Billing exceptions & invoicing: Karthik Iyer (Finance Ops)
- SLA/SC: Priyom Das (Sales Lead)

I've attached our GCP_Marketplace_Procurement_Checklist.pdf and a draft co-sell terms doc for reference. Can we set a 30-minute sync Thursday at 10:00am PT to walk the checklist?

Attachments: [attachment: GCP_Marketplace_Procurement_Checklist.pdf (PDF, 95KB)], [attachment: Redwood_CoSell_MAL-terms.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]

Thanks — Priyom

Quick notes from finance/ops perspective — copying short checklist items we need to land before we can accept a PO or enable marketplace billing: 

- Confirm remit-to and tax info on Acme's PO (standard fields: remit_to_address, tax_id, billing_contact_email).
- Decide billing flow: Marketplace metered billing is immediate (no invoice lag), but invoiced reseller requires billing account setup and credit checks (~5 business days).
- For invoiced deals we need an AR contact and purchase order number in PO field 10.
- If Acme wants consolidated monthly invoices across multiple projects, we need to set that up in our billing portal (requires signed reseller addendum).

I'll create a HubSpot ticket and tag Finance Ops; HubSpot id: ACME-98765. Vanessa — when Marketplace ops receives PO, can you hold activation until finance confirms?

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Billing & Marketplace Ops, Redwood Inference
